name: Ascend
tagline: An agent that watches how users interact with a site and redesigns the interface automatically.

awards: Best Use of AI / AI Agents Sponsored by Botpress

problem: Big tech optimises interfaces with analytics, designers and engineers in a slow loop small companies cannot afford.
solution: Tracks clicks, scroll depth and time on sections, proposes interface changes with an agent and renders them remotely, closing the loop without manual redeploys.
demo_moment: Team-described: compare two UIs and see the agent pick and apply the better one.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of AI / AI Agents Sponsored by Botpress” among 127 submissions.
Automates a costly product loop for small teams.

lessons: Agents that close a loop end to end impress agent-platform sponsors.
